title: Combining gene expression profiling and machine learning to diagnose B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
summary: The primary paper uses a random-forest classifier on targeted gene-expression profiling to classify B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes and reports concordance against expert pathology and assay references. This is a specific hematopathology diagnostic result; the authors frame it as a complement to pathology. Publisher/author-hosted full text, Methods and Results: RT-MLPSeq 137-marker assay, 510 biopsies and seven subtype classes; validation against expert pathology and NanoString/immunostain references.
